<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js';

// Concrete Dreams — a compact, arcade-style skate session.
const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x9ca8a3);
scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x9ca8a3, 42, 155);
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(54, innerWidth/innerHeight, .1, 260);
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true, powerPreference:'high-performance'});
renderer.setSize(innerWidth,innerHeight); renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio,1.8));
renderer.shadowMap.enabled=true; renderer.shadowMap.type=THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
renderer.outputColorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace; renderer.toneMapping=THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping; renderer.toneMappingExposure=1.15;
document.body.prepend(renderer.domElement);
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xdce9eb,0x443c32,2.1));
const sun=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffd5a4,3.0); sun.position.set(-25,38,-18); sun.castShadow=true; sun.shadow.mapSize.set(2048,2048); sun.shadow.camera.left=-55; sun.shadow.camera.right=55; sun.shadow.camera.top=55; sun.shadow.camera.bottom=-55; sun.shadow.bias=-.0002; scene.add(sun);
const fill=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x91bcd0,1.0); fill.position.set(20,14,24); scene.add(fill);
const mats={ concrete:new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x858985,roughness:.92}), pale:new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xb9b7a9,roughness:.88}), dark:new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x303a39,roughness:.8}), metal:new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xb8c1bd,metalness:.78,roughness:.27}), orange:new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xf06e48,roughness:.72}), lime:new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xc9e878,roughness:.8}), wood:new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x9b6946,roughness:.87}), blue:new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x3f727b,roughness:.85}), grass:new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x52654d,roughness:1}), black:new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x202426,roughness:.6})};
const box=(x,y,z,sx,sy,sz,mat, parent=scene)=>{const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(sx,sy,sz),mat);m.position.set(x,y,z);m.castShadow=true;m.receiveShadow=true;parent.add(m);return m};
const cyl=(x,y,z,r1,r2,h,mat,parent=scene,segments=12)=>{const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r1,r2,h,segments),mat);m.position.set(x,y,z);m.castShadow=true;m.receiveShadow=true;parent.add(m);return m};
const ground=box(0,-.32,22,150,.6,190,mats.concrete); ground.receiveShadow=true;
// Warm, worn park markings and pavement seams.
const lineMat=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xc2b7a0,roughness:1});
for(let i=-5;i<=5;i++){box(i*8,.002,20,.035,.01,170,lineMat);}
for(let z=-55;z<105;z+=12) box(0,.003,z,140,.01,.025,lineMat);
// Long shallow quarter-pipe ramps: a solid sculpted wedge with a smooth-looking ride face.
function ramp(x,z,w,len,h,rotation=0){
 const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry(); const v=[-w/2,0,-len/2, w/2,0,-len/2, -w/2,0,len/2, w/2,0,len/2, -w/2,h,len/2, w/2,h,len/2];
 g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(v,3)); g.setIndex([0,2,1,1,2,3,2,4,3,3,4,5,0,1,4,1,5,4,0,4,2,1,3,5]); g.computeVertexNormals();
 const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(g,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x9c9b8e,roughness:.8,side:THREE.DoubleSide}));mesh.position.set(x,0,z);mesh.rotation.y=rotation;mesh.castShadow=true;mesh.receiveShadow=true;scene.add(mesh);
 const lip=cyl(0,0,0,.11,.11,1,mats.metal);lip.rotation.z=Math.PI/2;lip.scale.set(1,1,w); // replace with horizontal coping bar
 lip.position.set(x,h,z+Math.cos(rotation)*len/2); lip.rotation.set(0,rotation,Math.PI/2);lip.scale.set(1,1,w); return {x,z,w,len,h,rotation,mesh};
}
const ramps=[];
ramps.push(ramp(0,19,9,13,2.2)); ramps.push(ramp(-22,7,9,12,1.7,Math.PI/2)); ramps.push(ramp(22,39,10,14,2.5,-Math.PI/2));
ramps.push(ramp(-4,65,11,15,2.3)); ramps.push(ramp(27,-22,10,12,2,Math.PI));
// Box ledges, curbs, rails and banks.
function rail(x,z,len,y=.85,rot=0){
 const group=new THREE.Group(); group.position.set(x,y,z);group.rotation.y=rot;scene.add(group);
 cyl(0,0,0,.07,.07,len,mats.metal,group,10).rotation.x=Math.PI/2;
 for(const zz of [-len*.43,len*.43]){cyl(0,-.42,zz,.055,.055,.84,mats.metal,group,8);box(0,-.82,zz,.48,.08,.32,mats.dark,group)}
 return {x,z,len,y,rot,group};
}
const rails=[rail(-7,8,7,.95),rail(8,27,9,.9,.08),rail(-17,42,8,1.15),rail(14,59,10,.88),rail(3,-11,8,.95)];
function ledge(x,z,w,len,h=.72){box(x,h/2,z,w,h,len,mats.pale);box(x,h+.025,z,w+.06,.06,len+.08,mats.orange);for(let zz=z-len/2+1;zz<z+len/2;zz+=2)box(x,h+.06,zz,.08,.018,.1,mats.dark)}
ledge(11,10,2,7,.68);ledge(-10,32,2.1,8,.8);ledge(5,48,2,6,.64);ledge(-28,58,2,9,.74);
// Central mini-bowl rim, nested rounded-looking concrete banks.
const bowlRim=cyl(-31,.1,17,13,13,.3,mats.pale,scene,48); bowlRim.scale.set(1,.18,.72);
const bowlIn=cyl(-31,-.42,17,11.8,11.8,.22,mats.blue,scene,48); bowlIn.scale.set(1,.12,.72);
// Low park features: picnic bench, block obstacles, planters and painted bollards.
for(let i=0;i<3;i++){box(30,.48,5+i*2,3.4,.95,.18,mats.wood);box(30,.9,5+i*2,3.6,.12,.26,mats.wood);for(const x of [28.8,31.2])box(x,.23,5+i*2,.15,.46,.17,mats.black)}
for(const [x,z] of [[-30,-2],[32,29],[-30,78],[34,74]]){box(x,.3,z,5,.6,3,mats.dark);box(x,.62,z,4.7,.08,2.7,mats.grass);for(let i=0;i<5;i++){cyl(x-1.6+i*.8,.92,z,.27,.15,.6,mats.grass);}}
for(const [x,z] of [[-15,-16],[19,-5],[-25,27],[25,52],[-14,75],[18,82]]){cyl(x,.4,z,.18,.23,.8,mats.orange);cyl(x,.83,z,.22,.2,.08,mats.pale);}
// Urban perimeter: fence, lit poles, and low city blocks fading into the haze.
for(let x=-55;x<=55;x+=5){cyl(x,1.5,-48,.045,.045,3,mats.dark);if(x<55)box(x+2.5,1.25,-48,5,.045,.045,mats.metal)}
for(let i=0;i<13;i++){const x=-65+i*11, h=10+(i*7%16), z=-72-(i%3)*8;const b=box(x,h/2,z,8,h,9,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:[0x657270,0x7d8179,0x526267][i%3],roughness:1}));for(let yy=2;yy<h-1;yy+=3)for(let xx=-2.5;xx<=2.5;xx+=2)box(x+xx,yy,z+4.52,.65,1.1,.04,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xb4a58c,emissive:0x382c1e,emissiveIntensity:.3}))}
// A few subtle palm-like park trees.
function tree(x,z){cyl(x,2,z,.2,.32,4,mats.wood);for(let i=0;i<5;i++){let a=i*1.25;const fr=cyl(x+Math.cos(a)*1.1,4.1,z+Math.sin(a)*1.1,.08,.35,2.4,mats.grass);fr.rotation.z=Math.cos(a)*.5;fr.rotation.x=Math.sin(a)*.5}}
for(const [x,z] of [[-39,-8],[39,13],[-39,49],[39,66]])tree(x,z);
// Skater rig: stylized hoodie, helmet, articulated arms and legs, and a real rolling deck.
const skater=new THREE.Group();scene.add(skater);
const rider=new THREE.Group();skater.add(rider);
const skin=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xb97855,roughness:.8}), hoodie=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xe75f43,roughness:.86}), pants=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x293d45,roughness:.9}), shoes=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xe9e5d7,roughness:.8});
const board=new THREE.Group();skater.add(board);
box(0,.16,0, .85,.13,2.05,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xd9a66e,roughness:.66}),board);
box(0,.235,0,.7,.025,1.6,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x222c2d,roughness:.9}),board);
for(const z of [-.65,.65]){box(0,.05,z,.6,.11,.16,mats.metal,board);for(const x of [-.31,.31]){const wheel=cyl(x,-.06,z,.13,.13,.11,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xe5ddd0,roughness:.55}),board,12);wheel.rotation.z=Math.PI/2;}}
function limb(parent,a,b,r,mat){const d=new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(b,a);const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r*.78,r,d.length,8),mat);m.position.copy(a).add(b).multiplyScalar(.5);m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),d.normalize());m.castShadow=true;parent.add(m);return m}
// Rider parts are built in local coordinates; pivots enable in-air pose changes.
cyl(0,1.56,0,.34,.3,.78,hoodie,rider,12);
const head=cyl(0,2.18,.03,.24,.25,.44,skin,rider,12);
const helmet=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(.27,12,8),mats.lime);helmet.position.set(0,2.38,.03);helmet.scale.set(1,.55,1);helmet.castShadow=true;rider.add(helmet);
box(0,1.04,-.03,.62,.48,.34,pants,rider);
for(const x of [-.2,.2]){limb(rider,new THREE.Vector3(x,1.02,0),new THREE.Vector3(x, .55, x*.28),.13,pants);limb(rider,new THREE.Vector3(x,.55,x*.28),new THREE.Vector3(x,.32,.28),.12,pants);box(x,.26,.34,.3,.14,.42,shoes,rider)}
for(const x of [-.39,.39]){limb(rider,new THREE.Vector3(x,1.82,0),new THREE.Vector3(x*1.5,1.5,.1),.105,hoodie);limb(rider,new THREE.Vector3(x*1.5,1.5,.1),new THREE.Vector3(x*1.55,1.25,.25),.085,skin)}
// Directional sun glow and a softly visible sky disc.
const sunBall=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(3,24,16),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xffd99d}));sunBall.position.set(-62,45,-105);scene.add(sunBall);

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D skate-park game with a two-minute trick run.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and read only the latest.

## Decisions
- Built an arcade-style game called “Concrete Dreams” using Three.js, with keyboard and touch controls, scoring, tricks, rails, and a 120-second session.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a playable game prototype and added a start screen, HUD, skate park, skater, and session timer in `index.html`.
- Captured and inspected JPEG screenshots at `screenshots/skate-park.jpg` and `screenshots/skate-gameplay.jpg`.
- JavaScript syntax check passed.

### Active
- Investigate and fix eight recurring Three.js errors: `THREE.BufferGeometry.computeBoundingSphere(): Computed radius is NaN. The "position" attribute is likely to have NaN values.`

### Blocked
- Browser visual verification is incomplete while the geometry errors remain unresolved.

## Next Move
1. Inspect the eight NaN geometry errors and identify which `CylinderGeometry` calls create invalid position attributes.
2. Fix the source and verify the browser console is clear of geometry errors.
3. Re-test a session and save/read a fresh JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Contains the game implementation and current geometry debugging code.
- `screenshots/skate-gameplay.jpg`: Previously captured gameplay screenshot; refresh after fixes.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
